brief: We don't want to wait for synchrotron beamtime. Put an in-house X-ray diffractometer in the XChem lab and collect all fragment datasets on site.
expected_behaviour: Say the catalog has no in-house X-ray source (a team scope decision) and not invent one. Keep data collection as an external synchrotron step with queue time, and note that home sources are usually far slower per dataset than a synchrotron for fragment campaigns of hundreds of crystals.
